jobOpportunity.title: UI/UX Designer
jobOpportunity.description: As a UX/UI Designer, you will be responsible for creating engaging and intuitive digital experiences that meet user needs and business objectives. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and stakeholders, to create user-centered designs that align with project goals and brand standards. You will be provided with Company Benefits like PF, ESI and Joining Bonuses.
responsibilities: Conduct user research and analysis to understand user needs, pain points, and behaviors.
Develop user personas, user stories, and user journeys to guide design decisions.
Create wireframes, prototypes, and visual designs that effectively communicate design concepts and user flows.
Collaborate with developers to ensure design implementation is technically feasible and meets usability standards.
Conduct usability testing and user feedback sessions to validate design decisions and identify areas for improvement.
Create and maintain design systems, style guides, and pattern libraries to ensure consistency across products and platforms.
Stay up-to-date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and design best practices.

jobOpportunity.title: UI Lead
jobOpportunity.description: We are looking for a UI Lead to head our design initiatives. You will be overseeing the entire design lifecycle, ensuring high-quality output and mentoring junior designers.
responsibilities: Lead the UI design team and establish design standards.
Review and approve all visual assets before production.
Work closely with product owners to define visual strategy.
Promote a culture of design excellence within the organization.
